function: Joint fluid-antenna port selection and decentralized opportunistic user scheduling at each UE to maximize downlink sum-rate in opportunistic FAMA, without BS precoding (p. 1, p. 3).
system: Multiuser downlink: multi-antenna BS (one fixed antenna per UE, no precoding); each UE has a K-port linear fluid antenna of size W wavelengths; no RIS; band not stated (p. 2).
method: Partially observable mean field multi-agent actor-critic (MFAC) reinforcement learning; fully connected actor and critic networks per UE, Adam, replay buffer, soft target updates (pp. 3-4).
data_channel: Custom simulation: spatially correlated Rayleigh fading across FAS ports with Jakes (Bessel J0) correlation; path loss and distances omitted; the only channel model used (p. 2).
test_conditions: Defaults K=100, M=6, W=2, |P|=30; trained per number of UEs (Fig. 2, Table I); sum-rate for M=3-10, K=30-100, W=1-5; no cross-condition testing (pp. 4-5).
baselines: Learned: MA SD3-DerivNet, earlier team-inspired multi-agent RL for O-FAMA [18]. Non-learned: exhaustive search as sum-rate upper bound (p. 4; Figs. 3-5).
metrics: Sum-rate (bps/Hz) versus number of UEs, ports, and fluid-antenna size; training convergence per episode; training time (pp. 4-5).
complexity: Critic complexity order O((|S_m|+2|A_m|)h_1 + sum h_i h_(i+1) + h_I), independent of M; exhaustive search O(M^2(K+1)^M); training time 405-662 s (Table I) (pp. 3-4).
q1_support: p. 2: "We assume that all channels follow a Rayleigh distribution" with port correlation that "follows the classical Jake’s model". Custom simulator only; no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO, or measured channels.
q2_support: p. 4: "Convergence for different numbers of UEs (M)" and "Table I shows the training time ... under different number of UEs": trained for each configuration; no test of a trained model in unseen conditions.
q3_support: p. 4: "We compare the proposed approach with (1) the MA SD3-DerivNet scheme proposed in [18] ... and (2) exhaustive search"; both appear in the sum-rate Figs. 3-5 (pp. 4-5).
q4_support: p. 3: "the complexity of our approach can be expressed as O((|Sm| + 2|Am|)h1 ...)"; p. 4, Table I: training time of the proposed approach 405s to 662s.
q5_support: p. 2: "We assume that all channels follow a Rayleigh distribution": simulated channels only; the paper gives no code or data link and uses no public channel dataset.
notes: Area 3 is a judgment call for the reviewer: the learned decision is fluid-antenna port selection (receive antenna position) jointly with opportunistic scheduling, and the BS uses no precoding (p. 1). I treated port selection as spatial configuration of a reconfigurable antenna, akin to receive beam or antenna selection; under a strict reading of area 3 (BS precoder, beams, RIS phases) the work would be excluded with reason 'function' (p. 1). Scheduling alone is above the PHY, but it is learned jointly with port selection, so above_phy does not apply. System check passes: multi-antenna BS and a K-port fluid antenna at each UE (pp. 1-2). Exhaustive search also appears in Table I as training time (p. 4).
